_comment: Copy to hardware.json and fill in for your wiring. Values marked TODO must be measured on the robot.
Joint angle = direction * motor output angle + offset. The calf motor sits on the thigh and drives the knee
through a 1:1 belt, so the calf uses the same formula. offset comes from deploy/scripts/calibrate.py.
One RS-485 bus per leg (port), motor ids 0 hip, 1 thigh, 2 calf; change freely, ids are per bus.

calibration_pose._comment: TODO: joint angles (rad) of a pose you can reproduce by hand or with a jig; calibrate.py sets offsets so the motors read these. Default = CAD assembly pose.

joystick._comment: Xbox-style pad on Linux: left stick y/x -> vx/vy, right stick x -> yaw rate; START stand, A walk, B damp. Check indices with jstest.
